findingDetails.title: Existing symlink at an explicit scaffold target bypasses repo containment
findingDetails.case: A repo-relative --path names an existing symlink directly under the repository whose target is outside the repository.
findingDetails.evidence: resolve_and_validate_create_target resolves the parent but appends the final basename without resolving it. Later mkdir and touch use that final path, so they follow the symlink.
findingDetails.userImpact: A caller expecting the documented repo-relative boundary can create or replace packet files in the symlink target.
findingDetails.scopeProof: The --path resolver at .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/spec/create.sh:1240 checks only the parent; the first writes are at .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/spec/create.sh:2103; template rendering is rooted in that destination at .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/lib/template-utils.sh:181.
findingDetails.recommendation: Reject an existing symlink target that resolves beyond the allowed repo root, before any mkdir or touch; test the final-component symlink case.
findingDetails.claim: An existing symlink at the final --path component allows a repo-relative scaffold to write outside the repository.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched for a later realpath/lstat check on FEATURE_DIR and for a symlink --path test; neither was found in the create path or CLI tests.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The hidden --path option intentionally permits an absolute /tmp target, but the repo-relative branch explicitly promises containment and gives no symlink exception.
findingDetails.confidence: high from code path; dynamic scaffold not run under lineage-only write boundary
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A later pre-write final-component containment guard is identified in the invoked path.
